Reaching Through Time

JohnsTarot
27-08-2026 • 25 minutos
Some people touch our lives without ever meeting us. Their words, teachings, and systems reach across decades—or even thousands of years—and help us see ourselves and the world differently.
In this episode of John’s Tarot, I reflect on the people and traditions that helped transform my life: Nichiren Daishonin and Buddhism, the ancient wisdom of the I Ching, Bill Wilson and Dr. Bob’s program of recovery, the philosophy of Alan Watts, the political insight of Noam Chomsky, and the symbolic work of Arthur Edward Waite, Pamela Colman Smith, and Carl Jung.
Each provided something I needed: a new perspective, a structure for living, a way to question appearances, or a symbolic language for exploring the deeper patterns of life. Although many of these people lived long before me, their work reached through time and became part of my own journey from addiction and inherited dysfunction toward awareness, meaning, and service.
